feature_contract.goal: Restore complete game speed/time/position HUD safe placement and legibility across 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 source resolutions and asymmetric Quest3 OpenXR left/right vertical FOV, retaining native semantics and binocular disparity.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Gameplay HUD semantic owner, native viewport, stereo edge geometry only. Do not alter F11, ESC, main menu, rank world billboards, GOAL, stage +TIME, SkyGlow, lens rings, FFB, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: Original speed, time, position sprite producers and native XYZRHW/c64 bounds in the OutRun D3D9 game.
R30 trusted HUD semantic classification, safe bounds, stereo queue geometry and bilateral eye-specific viewport affine.
R29 left/right D3D9Ex draw replay and OpenXR host per-eye composition, with original game fallback.
subcomponents: Full trusted peripheral HUD source bounds and semantic producer ownership for speed, time and position.
Left/right asymmetric eye vertical FOV safe-area shift with one shared correction retaining binocular disparity.
Native aspect/reset/resolution fallback and world/effects exclusions without affecting independent menus.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Complete speed/time/position HUD stays separately legible at peripheral source anchors with source-bounds preservation and binocular visibility across asymmetric left/right FOV and three source aspects.
Offscreen transitions and impossible shared fit retain prior offsets; 6th/6, GOAL, +TIME, SkyGlow, F11, ESC, world billboards and original D3D9 desktop/reset fallback remain unchanged.
All DX9Ex Active policy, game, host, full-chain Win32 and package checks plus Domain Isolation pass on one declared validation-bearing SHA; Quest3 optical result remains separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: User reported Quest3 3440x1440 HUD too close to upper centre; paired right-eye top clipping remained possible under asymmetric eye vertical FOV.
diagnosis.root_cause: R30 shared vertical safe-area adjustment used pre-eye FOV scalar HudScaleY/HudBiasY rather than the two final left/right eye Y affines and could clip the right-eye peripheral HUD.
source_trace: Original game XYZRHW HUD producer and semantic anchoring to trustworthy sprite source bounds.
R30 shared HUD y-shift compares both post-FOV eye scale/bias and intersects visible safe-area constraints.
R29 bilateral replay inherits the identical common edge shift while actual eye-specific stereo disparity remains distinct.
alternatives_rejected: Changing only global HudScaleY was rejected: asymmetric optical centres need the actual distinct left/right eye affine, not one pre-FOV approximation.
Clamping each eye independently was rejected: different left/right shifts destroy original binocular disparity.
Blindly re-centering all XYZRHW primitives was rejected: it would contaminate world rank, stage effects and pause-menu semantics.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Source material 7b01af4886b9e50d34ed2bd23fcd027abf5ec896 added paired-eye vertical FOV fit with common y correction in R30 and bilateral verifier fixtures.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Material adds four destructive source mutants plus paired-eye top/bottom fixtures at four aspect resolutions, infeasible fit and transition safeguards; exact-SHA CI not yet green.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Trusted peripheral ScreenHud uses common safe-area bias with per-eye affine; 3D billboards, rank markers and stage effects must not inherit HUD correction.
diagnosis.runtime_limit: No matching Quest3/VDXR headset or user screenshot validation of this commit; visual correctness not claimed.
